cohort_policy: earliest study year only; exclude other years including unlabelled data

development.ladder: A3 = A2 + the seasonal equivariance objective. Replaces the contrastive seasonal term, which makes amplitude and phase INVARIANT to augmentation and is why training currently degrades acrophase recovery below random initialisation (0.769 -> 0.587).
development.rq2_independence: Equivariance trains on the 12-h harmonic (HRD bin 14); RQ2 perturbs whole-window timing and the 24-h amplitude, so RQ2 stays an independent probe. GLOBEM cannot resolve 12 h and has no RQ2, so its 24-h fallback contaminates nothing.
